notes: Borough + NTA neighborhood region show/hide toggles (Land Value 3D tab + Parking tab). Columns added by augment_nyc_regions.py (parcels) / augment_parking_regions.py (parking) from NYC DCP's 2020 NTA layer; the bake emits metadata.groups (H3_CATEGORICAL_FIELDS).

2026-10: values switched from MapPLUTO AssessLand/AssessTot (fractional ASSESSED: class 1 at 6% of market, classes 2/4 at 45%) to DOF MARKET values (NYC Open Data 8y4t-faws, FY2027 final roll = year 2027 period 3, curmktland/curmkttot) via data/jurisidictions/run_nyc_market.py. Condo unit values summed onto the PLUTO billing lot by (boro, condo_number, block). Assessed values kept as assessed_land_value/assessed_total_value. Caveat: DOF values class 2 (rental/co-op/condo) land via the income approach, often far below class 1 land next door.
